velocity.reason: 2013 AIR velocity not validated; published instrument limitations
velocity.detail: Kurdzo et al. (2017), p. 918 and Table 2, report technical difficulties and do not present radial velocity before 2014. The later archive contains VEL, but provides no verified correction or validation history. Those values are retained only for audit, not displayed as usable winds.

volume.coordinateSystem: Radar-centered spherical azimuthal equidistant horizontal plane; x east, y north; z altitude above mean sea level, meters

geolocation.note: Rendered directly from archived radar location, true-north azimuth and range. An independent comparison flags several-kilometer disagreement between a first-frame circulation feature and the contemporaneous NWS track; the source of that discrepancy is unresolved. Do not use AIR pixels for a precise tornado position or chase-distance estimate.

processing.spatial: Nearest native elevation, azimuth and range gate. All 45 archived tilts are decoded; outside sector, range and half-elevation edge support is missing. No gap fill or beam smoothing.
processing.geometry: Inverse standard 4/3-Earth beam geometry including recorded radar altitude. Horizontal coordinates are spherical surface arc distance and true bearing, not flat slant distance.
processing.time: All 45 elevations share one volume interval, consistent with simultaneous elevation imaging. Display time is global interval midpoint; original ray times are zero and clock accuracy remains unverified.
processing.quantization: 0 is missing; codes 1..255 represent (code-1)*0.5-32 dBZ. Nearest 0.5 dBZ with at most 0.25 dBZ quantization error unless explicitly counted clipping occurs.
processing.resolution: Cartesian display sampling is approximately 354 by 281 by 167 m. This does not establish independent spatial resolution. Native 30 m range sampling, published 45 m independent range resolution and roughly 1-degree receive beams are distinct.
processing.cropping: Grid covers x -45..23 km, y 0..45 km, z 0..16 km MSL. Data below 0 m MSL or outside that box are omitted. The 0 m floor is a reference plane, not a terrain model.
processing.interpretation: Reflectivity volume, not a solid cloud boundary, surface tornado outline, or wind-speed measurement. Source registration and calibration remain unverified.
